summary: iter-342 Phase B (extended replacement fields + R1/R2 chain) and Phase C (Analytics dashboard + CSV export + RBAC) — backend 19/19 pass. Frontend admin analytics page + Access denied gate + Compliance link all rendered/behaving correctly by soft navigation (avatar → profile → link). Direct hard-nav (page.goto) loses in-memory token as expected per iter-341 note. One testability issue found: several `data-testid` attributes on React Native `View`/`TextInput` in survival-analytics.tsx and ImplantLifecycleTimeline.tsx are NOT forwarded to the web DOM because RN Web only forwards `testID` prop for View primitives — profile link works because it sets BOTH `data-testid` and `testID`.

minor.issue: Response `filters` object echoes date range keys as `from`/`to` while the request query params are `from_date`/`to_date`. Inconsistent — either rename the response keys to match, or document. Currently frontend doesn't consume filters echo, so no user-facing impact.

Filter value is lowercased in the response echo (`system: 'spi'`) — while data rows preserve original casing (`SPI`). Matching against DB values must therefore be case-insensitive; verify that internally in `_compute_analytics` (currently appears correct: SPI row still gets counted).

ui_bugs.issue: `data-testid` set directly on RN `<View>` is dropped by React Native Web. Automated tests cannot find [data-testid='metric-placed'], [data-testid='metric-active'], [data-testid='metric-failed'], [data-testid='metric-survival'], [data-testid='metric-repl-success'], [data-testid='metric-repl-refail'], [data-testid='metric-repl-rate'], [data-testid='analytics-export-csv'], [data-testid='filter-system'], [data-testid='filter-from-date'], [data-testid='filter-to-date'], [data-testid='filter-apply'], [data-testid='filter-tooth-*'], [data-testid='row-system-*'], [data-testid='row-tooth-*'], [data-testid='row-reason-*'], [data-testid='row-month-*']. Fix: add `testID={testid}` alongside `data-testid={testid}` (mirror the pattern used in profile.tsx line 267-268).
Same testID/data-testid gap — `implant-lifecycle-timeline`, `lifecycle-position-{tooth}`, `lifecycle-event-{tooth}-{idx}` all invisible to Playwright. Add `testID` prop alongside `data-testid`.

issues: Tooth-bucket chip labels shown in UI as 'Anterior maxilla / Posterior maxilla / Anterior mandible / Posterior mandible' but backend + review-request document them as 'Anterior Max / Posterior Max / Anterior Mand / Posterior Mand'. Consistent copy would help downstream docs; functionally identical.

action_items: Add `testID={testid}` in addition to `data-testid={testid}` in /app/frontend/app/admin/survival-analytics.tsx (CounterCard, BarRow, monthly row, TextInput filters, TouchableOpacity chips & buttons) so Playwright/RTL selectors work on web (RN Web forwards `testID` to `data-testid` for primitives).

Consider aligning /api/analytics/survival `filters` echo keys with request param names (`from_date`/`to_date` instead of `from`/`to`) for API contract consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~L4262: `survival_map: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]` is keyed by int and re-stringified at L4327 for Mongo. This works but violates the type annotation. Prefer `Dict[str, ...]` from the start.

server.py ~L4285-L4295: When R2 arrives, the code moves prior replacement into the chain with `status: 'Failed'`. However for R3 the chain will only contain the direct prior — because it does `chain = list(prior.get('chain') or [])` then `append`. Verify R3+ preserves full history; the current pattern should work but add a test that submits R3 to confirm chain length becomes 2.

survival-analytics.tsx L107: CSV filename hardcoded `implanr-survival-analytics.csv` — the backend supplies a timestamped filename in Content-Disposition; use that or embed timestamp on the client to avoid overwrite when downloading twice.

survival-analytics.tsx AuthContext-loading race: While loading, the page currently renders the role gate block card ('Access denied') if user role isn't yet resolved. Confirm the `loading` flag from AuthContext is honored — a hard reload without a token flashes 'Access denied' before router redirect. Acceptable but could be smoother with an ActivityIndicator during loading state.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — page renders correctly for admin and blocks student; only automated data-testid selectors miss because of the RN Web View forwarding gap (visual verification via screenshots covers what selectors couldn't).

rca of the issue: Frontend data-testid selectors returned count=0 for metric-placed/active/failed/survival/repl-*/analytics-export-csv/filter-system. Root cause: React Native Web only forwards `testID` prop to the resulting DOM element for View/TextInput primitives; the `data-testid` prop passed directly is treated as an unknown React prop and dropped. Fix: add `testID` alongside `data-testid` (see profile.tsx L267-268 for the working dual-attribute pattern). No fix applied — this is business/component-level code and belongs to the main agent.
